column2: # Install and load the randomForest library
# Clean outcome structures for classification mapping
rf_female <- randomForest(TenYearCHD_Fact ~ age + cigsPerDay + sysBP + totChol + glucose, data = female_cohort, ntree = 300)
rf_male <- randomForest(TenYearCHD_Fact ~ age + cigsPerDay + sysBP + totChol + glucose, data = male_cohort, ntree = 300)
# Set up a side-by-side plot layout
barplot(t(importance_female), main = "Female Risk Factor Priorities", col = "#E7298A", las = 2, ylab = "Mean Decrease Gini")
